additional_info.subject: ID0472717-DC/Si-D/SE-[Y2/T94002909246] Charger Out of Order CRM:03289000273
additional_info.body:
Hi Magnus,
As we've discussed today, the problem doesn't seem to be FW related as the charger has been working for some time.
Since all the converters are showing CANCommLoss from my perspective, it's either KF9 or XD14.1:
Please take a spare KF9 to avoid further visits. I would first try to remove the XD14.1 and reestablish the connection again, check the wirings to KF9 or any bended pins and after replace it if necessary.
Let me know if I can move this to RC-SE or if I keep this for a few days.
Thanks!
BR,
Francisco
